en_title: Ubisoft Shares Cryptic Assassins Creed Codename Hexe Update
cn_title: 育碧公布《刺客信条》Hexe密文
subtitle: 线索等你破解
opus_summary: 育碧表示，代号Hexe的《刺客信条》新作正稳步推进，下一次重大消息将在2027年公布。官方还在博客中留下了一段加密信息，可能透露有关该项目的线索。

paragraphs.en: Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe was announced all the way back in 2022, but aside from a spooky teaser, we still don't know much about it. In a new blog post, Ubisoft has shared a cryptic clue that may shed some light on the project — if you're able to decode it, that is.
paragraphs.cn: 代号Hexe的《刺客信条》新作早在2022年就已公布，但除了一支诡异的先导预告片，我们对它仍知之甚少。育碧在最新博客中分享了一条神秘线索，或许能让我们对这个项目多些了解——前提是你能破解它。

paragraphs.en: In the blog post , Ubisoft laid out its vision for the future of Assassin's Creed, and, of course, Codename Hexe is a big part of that future. At first glance, the update on the upcoming game is vague; the blog post simply says, "We're making steady progress on this darker Assassin's Creed experience, though there is still work ahead of us. We know the wait has been long, and we're grateful for your patience and continued enthusiasm for the project."
paragraphs.cn: 育碧在这篇博客中阐述了《刺客信条》系列的未来规划，而代号Hexe的新作自然是其中的重要一环。乍看之下，官方对这款新作的介绍仍很模糊，博客只是写道：「这部风格更黑暗的《刺客信条》作品正稳步推进，不过我们还有工作尚待完成。我们知道大家已经等了很久，感谢各位的耐心，以及对这个项目始终不减的热情。」

paragraphs.en: But it seems like more concrete updates will be coming next year, with the post continuing, "The team remains focused on delivering the unique vision at the heart of this project, and we'll share our next major update in 2027 ." That's pretty much all the information about Hexe that Ubisoft has shared, so it seems like we'll have to wait until next year to get some concrete information about the game.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，明年似乎会有更具体的消息。博客接着写道：「团队仍专注于实现这个项目的独特核心构想，我们将在2027年分享下一次重大消息。」育碧分享的Hexe相关信息基本就这些，看来我们得等到明年，才能了解到这款游戏的一些具体情况。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft did include a little clue for dedicated players with a knack for decyphering coded messages, though. After the Codename Hexe entry, Ubisoft simply writes: "ZKLWAVN MBEXNK ULYCNJ... LWY01... I#########F // QNTMAKHX TWTEMZL. YSIZKQ AADSWX NFAAMPHP.//" I'm not sure what that means, if anything, but I'm sure that fans will be able to decode it eventually.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，育碧确实为那些热衷解谜、擅长破解密文的玩家留下了一点线索。在代号Hexe的介绍之后，育碧只写下了这样一段文字：「ZKLWAVN MBEXNK ULYCNJ... LWY01... I#########F // QNTMAKHX TWTEMZL. YSIZKQ AADSWX NFAAMPHP.//」我不确定这段文字有什么含义，甚至不确定它是否有含义，但我相信粉丝们最终能破解它。

paragraphs.en: Whatever it ends up being called, Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe is likely to be the first mainline Assassin's Creed game after 2025's Assassin's Creed Shadows. Other than the spooky theme of its only teaser, we don't know much about when it's going to take place, but I'd imagine that witchcraft is going to be a major theme.
paragraphs.cn: 无论最终定名如何，代号Hexe的《刺客信条》新作很可能成为2025年《刺客信条：影》之后的首部系列正传。除了唯一一支先导预告片呈现出的诡异主题，我们对故事发生的时代还不太了解，不过我猜巫术会是本作的重要主题。

paragraphs.en: We know little else about the game so far. Earlier this year, a leaker suggested a popular Assassin's Creed character would be returning. We've also heard that the game has been reworked internally to change some of its more magical elements. It has also gone through some staffing shakeups earlier this year, after the game director and creative director left the project.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，我们对这款游戏的其他情况也知之甚少。今年早些时候，一名爆料者暗示，一位人气《刺客信条》角色将会回归。我们还听说，团队已在内部调整游戏，改动了其中一些魔法色彩较浓的元素。今年早些时候，游戏总监和创意总监退出项目后，团队也经历了一些人事变动。
